description: Y documents made by crates/collab, written by its test (FVOCI_WRITE_VECTORS=1 cargo test -p fvoci-collab --test vectors). documents: from_body of every body contracts/ydoc-vectors.json has under documents and bodies. repairs: every repair of that file after repair. The web app's test reads each with the editor's binding and expects the JSON of the vector of the same name, and that the editor deletes nothing more. mended: every vector of that file under refused and shortened that the server repairs, after repair, with json, the body the server reads from it; the web app's test expects an editor to read the same, and to delete nothing.
